name: manual_c22a66
claim: Verify every quotation and cited line an agent supplies before relaying it: check line counts, locations and verbatim text against the exact commit, and reject design fields whose cited lines do not contain them. Require 'verbatim, or label paraphrase', and treat a second agent's agreement as evidence, never as approval.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-20: a peer agent's guidance cited real lines but wrapped paraphrases in quotation marks and justified three event fields (revocation_epoch, disposition_ref, cascade_version) by lines that do not mention them; checking against the exact commit caught it.
